examples.title: Example 1: Using onHover
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the onHover event on a button. When the mouse or stylus hovers over the button, the event is triggered to dynamically change the text content and background color of the button.

examples.title: Example 2: Using onHoverMove
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the onHoverMove event on a button, available since API version 15. When a stylus hovers over the button, the UI displays the current stylus position.
